name: Oracle failed logon burst
author: Sentra SOC
description: 10 or more failed Oracle database logons (ORA-1017 / 28000 …) for the same database account on one host within 5 minutes (unified audit syslog, traditional audit syslog or the collector's audit-trail rows).

name: Oracle DBA logon outside business hours
author: Sentra SOC
description: Successful logon by SYS / SYSTEM or with SYSDBA-family privileges (fields.dba) outside the configured business hours (After-hours monitoring settings; default Sun-Thu 08:00-17:00 Asia/Riyadh).

name: Oracle DBA or SYSDBA privilege granted
author: Sentra SOC
description: GRANT of DBA, SYSDBA/SYSOPER/SYSBACKUP, GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE/ROLE, ALTER/CREATE/DROP USER, BECOME USER, SELECT/READ ANY TABLE or similar powerful privileges (fields.grant_dba).

name: Oracle audit policy disabled
author: Sentra SOC
description: NOAUDIT / NOAUDIT POLICY / DROP AUDIT POLICY — a unified or traditional audit policy was switched off or removed.

name: Oracle database user created or dropped
author: Sentra SOC
description: CREATE USER or DROP USER recorded by Oracle auditing (every account change on a production database should map to a change ticket).

name: Mass data access from a non-application account
author: Sentra SOC
description: 200 or more audited SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/EXECUTE statements within 5 minutes by an account that is not an application account (fields.app_account; patterns APP_* / SVC_* / *_APP / *_USER / *_OWNER — tune in the rule override).

name: Oracle backup failed or older than 48 hours
author: Sentra SOC
description: Last RMAN job (V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS) did not complete, no backup job exists, or the last completed backup is 48 h or older (collector backup-status sample).

name: Oracle instance or listener down
author: Sentra SOC
description: The collector reports an instance that is not OPEN (or ACTIVE) or a listener that is not READY.

name: Oracle tablespace or recovery area nearly full
author: Sentra SOC
description: A tablespace is 90 % (or more) used or the fast recovery area is 85 % (or more) used — the database will stop accepting writes / archiving when it fills up.

name: Oracle Data Guard apply or transport lag
author: Sentra SOC
description: Standby apply or transport lag above the collector threshold (default 600 s) or a gap / destination error — the disaster-recovery copy is falling behind.
